etymologies.heading: Etymology
paragraphs: Originally nautical slang, from Portuguese palavra (“word”), from Late Latin parabola (“parable, speech”). The term's use (especially in Africa) mimics the evolution of the word moot. As such, for sense development, see moot. Doublet of parable, parole, and parabola.
senses: (Canada, US, archaic in Britain) Talk, especially unnecessary talk; chatter. [from 18th c.]
